notes: Verified modern scholarly doctoral-thesis Work awarded by the University of Groningen on 25 September 1997 and reported as 405 pages. It grounds a detailed reconstruction of the elementary Nippur sequence from lexical lists and exercise-tablet relations. The Work is not the ancient curriculum, a school organization, House F, a tablet Collection, a physical artifact, or transparent institutional policy. The 2023 chapter Reconstructing the Elementary Nippur Curriculum is a separate contained Work and supplies a current control: curriculum is a modern reconstructive label, not evidence for one Babylonian school board. Scribal Worlds 2026 remains a classification and contextualization control, not direct supersession. Only bibliographic identity and an unreviewed source-reported authorship claim are admitted; no thesis payload, Expression, Edition, Item, tablet, text, translation, semantic claim, graph relation, or canon state is created.
